notes.note: Reviewed the narrow html-preview startup delta against chromium-server-host.ts, html-reply-preview.ts and their caller/host/process tests. Only the disposable preview opts into effective WebRTC-policy verification; its internal prefs diagnostic target closes before authored targets. Browser-pane defaults, public CDP authority, host-adapter ownership and SSE transport are unchanged. The preview requires effective disable_non_proxied_udp without URL overrides; synthetic override/unreadable cases refuse, and live system Chromium passed with zero loopback/LAN UDP. Real enterprise policy configuration was not exercised. The shipped manual now scopes nested-frame WebRTC residuals to the published viewer; the user guide/decision own preview refusal and exact load-bearing preference details. No whole-document or historical runtime requalification is claimed.
